entries.ffb78ab795d5d102: It is the core business of the group, carried out by consolidated subsidiary PALEMO Co., Ltd. It operates a chain of specialty stores for women's apparel and miscellaneous goods in shopping centers nationwide; the number of stores as of February 20, 2026 was 227. Sales results for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥13,911 million.
